by
  intro F E _ _ _ _ _
  exact ⟨IsGalois.intermediateFieldEquivSubgroup, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl, fun K => IsGalois.card_fixingSubgroup_eq_finrank K⟩
target_source: ∀ (F E : Type*) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] [FiniteDimensional F E] [IsGalois F E], ∃ e : IntermediateField F E ≃o (Subgroup (E ≃ₐ[F] E))ᵒᵈ, (∀ K : IntermediateField F E, OrderDual.ofDual (e K) = K.fixingSubgroup) ∧ (∀ H : Subgroup (E ≃ₐ[F] E), e.symm (OrderDual.toDual H) = IntermediateField.fixedField H) ∧ ∀ K : IntermediateField F E, Nat.card K.fixingSubgroup = Module.finrank K E
